title: Cucumber Chicken Roll-ups
description: These easy-to-make cucumber roll-ups filled with a chicken mixture topped with crunchy Snack Factory Pretzel Crisps are a tasty summer appetizer.
ingredients: 1 (12.5 fl oz) can chicken breast, drained and flaked
0.5 teaspoon red pepper flakes, or to taste
1 (7.2 ounce) package Original Snack Factory® Pretzel Crisps®

steps.text: Slice cucumber halves lengthwise with a mandoline or knife into 1/8-inch-thick long slices
Mix together chicken, Neufchâtel cheese, tomato, green onions, mayonnaise, red pepper flakes, and garlic salt in a large bowl until well blended.

Lay cucumber slices flat on a work surface. Spoon 2 teaspoons chicken mixture on the bottom (flat) edge of each slice; roll up. Secure with toothpicks and place rolls upright like cups on a serving plate. Push a Snack Factory Pretzel Crisp about halfway down into chicken mixture.
